verdict.rationale: ADK's docs show an agent defined in about five lines of code: a name, a model, an instruction and a tools list. The GitHub README says custom functions can serve as tools and that tools are defined directly in Python code, so the core of the story is delivered. Missing for 10: evidence that custom tools are typed (e.g., schemas derived from type hints or docstrings), a concrete code example of a custom function tool (the snippet uses the built-in google_search), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
